[[John Pelphrey]] |stadium= [[O'Connell Center]] |champion= SEC regular season champions |bowl= [[2013 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result= Elite Eight }} {{2012–13 SEC men's basketball standings}} The '''2012–13 Florida Gators men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Florida]] in the sport of [[college basketball|basketball]] during the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2012–13 college basketball season]]. The Gators competed in [[NCAA Division I|Division I]] of the [[National Collegiate Athletic Association]] (NCAA) and the [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC). They were led by head coach [[Billy Donovan]], and played their home games in the [[O'Connell Center]] on the university's [[Gainesville, Florida]] campus. The Gators finished the SEC regular season with a 14–4 conference record, earning their sixth SEC regular season championship. As a No. 3 seed in the [[2013 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]], the Gators advanced to the Elite Eight for the third consecutive year where they were defeated by [[2012–13 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|Michigan]]. ==Previous season== {{main|2011–12 Florida Gators men's basketball team}} The Gators finished the 2011–12 season with a record of 26–11 overall, a 10–6 record in SEC play and lost in the Elite Eight round of the [[2012 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] to [[2011–12 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team|Louisville]].[https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/team/schedule/_/id/57/year/2012/florida-gators 2011–12 Florida Gators men's basketball team], Freshman shooting guard [[Bradley Beal]], who finished second on the team in scoring average, decided to forgo his sophomore season and enter the [[2012 NBA draft]]. He was selected by the [[Washington Wizards]] with the third overall pick.{{cite web|url=http://www.gatorcountry.com/basketball/article/washington_wizards_draft_brad_beal_3rd_overall/|title=Wizards
